parsed.claim: This does not prove the Type 0 vs Type 1 equivalence from the probe idea, which would need a separable-subrepresentation reduction. It only checks non-vacuity: the trivial group, as a CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}, satisfies HasKazhdanPropertyT. The definition is therefore satisfiable and not trivially false.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_trivial_group_T :
    ConnesRigidity.HasKazhdanPropertyT.{0}
      (⟨PUnit.{1}, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩ : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}) := by
  intro H _ _ _ π h
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, _⟩ := h ∅ 1 one_pos
  refine ⟨ξ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    simp [h0] at hξ
  · intro g
    have hg : g = 1 := by
      first | rfl | exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hg
    simp
